item.title: On a testé la caméra Philips Hue Play Screen Sync : la synchronisation sans HDMI a un angle mort inattendu
item.description: Lancée en septembre 2026, la caméra Philips Hue Play Screen Sync synchronise les lumières Hue avec n'importe quelle source affichée sur la télévision. Sur notre LG C4 de 77 pouces, son objectif fisheye ne voit pourtant pas les deux coins supérieurs de l'image.

item.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
item.description: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no longer appears on the commercial terms page: … Meta may use any content from such domains, web pages, or URLs to provide, develop, improve, […]
